FIELDS.NAME: Crystal Clear Glass LLC
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
"DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS": "Crystal Clear Glass LLC specializes in providing high-quality glass and window installation, repair, and replacement services for residential clients. Our operations focus on low-rise buildings, ensuring a controlled work environment that minimizes potential risks associated with high-rise projects. We maintain a comprehensive set of safety protocols, including regular training for all employees, to promote a secure workplace. 

Our team of skilled technicians performs the majority of work directly, allowing us to oversee quality and safety effectively. We also prioritize using well-documented transport procedures for our service vehicles, ensuring that all glass panels are secured properly during transit to avoid accidents and damage. 

Additionally, we verify that all subcontractors used in our operations are insured and adhere to our high standards, further safeguarding our clients' interests. By focusing on residential projects and maintaining strict compliance with local building codes, Crystal Clear Glass LLC effectively mitigates risks related to our operations while providing exceptional service to our customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in large-scale construction or high-rise glazing projects and confirms that all operations are limited to buildings three stories or less. We have established formal, written safety protocols and conduct regular safety training for our employees, ensuring a consistently safe work environment. Additionally, we manage all our work directly and do not rely on subcontractors, affirming our commitment to maintaining oversight and compliance throughout our operations. We do not perform any work involving the removal or replacement of window displays."
